sentence_stem: Because he has got a cold,
correct_completion: he is staying at home today.
full_sentence: Because he has got a cold, he is staying at home today.
acceptable_variants: he is resting in bed today.
he is not going to school today.

options.text: he has got a new car.
options.why_wrong: A new car is not a result of having a cold, so it does not complete the cause and effect meaning of 'because'.
This is a fact about his hobbies. It is not a result of having a cold.

options.text: he is staying at home today.

options.why_wrong: This describes his friends, not what he does because of his illness.

explanation: The word 'because' introduces the reason, so the second part must show the result of having a cold. Look for the option that describes what happens as a consequence.
translation: Оскільки в нього застуда, він сьогодні залишається вдома.
